channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran war live: Fighting intensifies in Yemen, hundreds killed or injured
item.description: Fighting intensifies across Yemen as the army says 474 attacks in 24 hours killed or wounded 1,540 Houthi fighters.

item.title: North Korea fires ballistic missile towards the sea, South Korea says
item.description: A ballistic missile fired from the North Korean port city of Wonsan flies more than 700km, South Korea's military says.

item.title: Why Carney’s economic overhaul is clashing with Canada’s unions
item.description: Unions say proposed changes to Canada's labour laws could weaken workers’ right to strike.

item.title: Iraq grants Iranian airlines 40 daily Najaf flights after US exemption
item.description: Mahan Air is excluded from the agreement as Baghdad says Washington granted its request for a waiver.

item.title: Netanyahu says Flydubai attacker had 'Islamist radical indoctrination'
item.description: Israel's prime minister says the pilot who tried to take over the Flydubai plane clearly intended to "down the plane".

item.title: Renee Good: Family of US woman killed by ICE agent sues Trump officials
item.description: Lawyers for Good's family say US officials created "an unprecedented environment for state sponsored violence" in Minneapolis.
